description: This file implements an AST traverser to remove dynamic indexing of non-SSBO vectors and matrices in shader code, replacing them with function calls for component access. It defines classes and functions for pattern matching, code transformation, and helper function generation related to dynamic indexing in shader compilation.

classes.name: RemoveDynamicIndexingTraverser
classes.description: An AST traverser class that identifies and replaces dynamic indexing of vectors and matrices with function calls, managing helper function insertion and side effect removal.

methods.name: GetIndexFunctionName
methods.description: Generates a unique function name for dynamic index access based on the type and operation (read/write).

methods.name: CreateIntConstantNode
methods.description: Creates a constant integer node for use in switch-case statements.

methods.name: EnsureSignedInt
methods.description: Converts a node to a signed integer type if it isn't already.

methods.name: GetFieldType
methods.description: Returns the type of a specific component (field) in a vector or matrix type.

methods.name: GetBaseType
methods.description: Returns the base type for indexing functions, setting high precision and qualifiers.

methods.name: GetIndexFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Creates a function definition for dynamic index access or modification for a specific type.

methods.name: RemoveDynamicIndexingTraverser
methods.description: Constructor for the traverser class, initializing pattern matcher, symbol table, and diagnostics.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Overrides traversal to handle binary nodes representing indirect indexing, replacing or emulating dynamic indexing.

methods.name: insertHelperDefinitions
methods.description: Inserts helper functions for indexed types into the AST.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Prepares the traverser for another traversal iteration, resetting flags.
